title: Focus & breaks
intro: Independent switches, saved locally for next time. Timers start only when you choose.
timerHelp: A user-chosen focus interval, not measured writing time. Expiry gives a gentle notice without saving, switching screens or starting a break.
focusComplete: Your focus interval is complete. Save when convenient and take a break at your own pace.
breakComplete: Your break is complete. Continue writing when you are ready.
otherProject: This focus interval and its summary belong to the original project. Switching pages does not change their statistics scope.
boundaryUnavailable: Saved-event boundaries are unavailable. The timer still works; this interval will not show a word-count summary.
summaryLoading: Reading saved manuscript changes for this interval…
summaryUnavailable: The complete saved-event interval could not be verified, so no word-count summary is shown. Your text and timer are unaffected.
summaryNet: Focus timer {{time}} · saved net change {{net}} Chinese characters
summaryHelp_one: Timer format is minutes:seconds and excludes pauses. Counts {{count}} manuscript save between this project’s start and end boundaries, including saves made while paused. Deletions are negative; identical saves add zero. Unsaved drafts are excluded. Do not infer writing speed from this summary.
summaryHelp_other: Timer format is minutes:seconds and excludes pauses. Counts {{count}} manuscript saves between this project’s start and end boundaries, including saves made while paused. Deletions are negative; identical saves add zero. Unsaved drafts are excluded. Do not infer writing speed from this summary.
typewriterHelp: After input or deletion, keep the active line near the middle of the viewport. Text, undo history and selection are preserved.
typingSoundHelp: A quiet bundled sound plays only on actual input. Turn it off at any time. Input content is never read or uploaded.
audioUnavailable: Typing audio is unavailable and has stopped. Editing still works; toggle the sound off and on to retry.
wellbeingHelp: Off by default. Opt in to local foreground editor activity only; notices never interrupt saves or AI tasks.
activityDefinition: Counts only while this app is visible and focused, the manuscript editor is visible, and input or deletion occurred in the last 60 seconds. Idle, background and minimized time are excluded. This is not writing time.
eyeRule: After 20 accumulated minutes of foreground editing activity, look about 20 feet (6 metres) away for at least 20 seconds when convenient. No forced pause.
sitNotice: When convenient, stand up and gently move your shoulders and neck.
eyeNotice: Give your eyes a break: look about 20 feet (6 metres) away for at least 20 seconds when convenient.
rested: I took a break — restart the cycle
mutedForRun: Muted for this session. Local foreground activity continues to count.
localPrivacy: Activity tracking, reminders and sound stay local. They are never uploaded or included in AI context.
storageUnavailable: Local preference storage is unavailable. These switches work for now, but may not be restored next time.
defaultsWait: End or cancel the current timer before restoring default preferences.
defaultsHelp: Restore local preferences without clearing today’s totals or changing your manuscript.
defaultsRestored: Default preferences restored. Today’s totals and your manuscript are unchanged.
preparationCancelled: Preparation cancelled. This timer never started; other editing aids are unchanged.
independentReminders: Choose each reminder below. Enabling activity tracking does not turn reminders on automatically.
activityBACKGROUND: Paused: the app is in the background or unfocused
activityNO_EDITOR: Paused: no manuscript editor is currently visible
activityIDLE: Paused: waiting for editing input (none in the last 60 seconds)
nextSitting: Movement reminder after {{time}} more foreground activity
nextEye: Eye reminder after {{time}} more foreground activity
remindersOff: Both reminders are off. Local foreground activity totals remain available.
openReminder: Open the break reminder and cycle settings
bothNotice: When convenient, stand up and move, and look about 20 feet (6 metres) away for at least 20 seconds. Your work will not be paused.
quickStartTitle_one: Start a {{count}}-minute focus interval without opening settings
quickStartTitle_other: Start a {{count}}-minute focus interval without opening settings
enterFocusLayout: Hide navigation and reference panels using the existing focus layout
exitFocusLayout: Leave focus layout and restore workspace panels
soundZeroVolume: Typing sound is enabled but its volume is zero. Adjust it under Editor feel.
postponeHelp: Postpone only this reminder until 5 more minutes of foreground editing activity. Background, minimized and idle time do not count. Regular reminder cycles are unchanged.
deferredRemaining: Postponed reminder after {{time}} more foreground activity
summaryRetryHelp: The summary read failed, but both save-event boundaries are frozen. Retry the same local read-only request; later saves will not be added. Changed historical records may still prevent recovery.
summaryBoundsUnavailable: Reliable start and end save-event boundaries are unavailable, so this interval’s exact word change cannot be recovered. No new end boundary or invented count will be used. Your manuscript and timer are unaffected.
